trip.name: Venice + Dolomites 2026
trip.summary: Venice 1.5 days → early lunch at VCE and Target Rent pickup near VCE at 13:30 → Noventa di Piave outlet, dedicated dinner and a supermarket stop for the 12 Sep breakfast and sandwiches → late arrival at the confirmed Airbnb east-base lodging on Via Corte in Auronzo di Cadore → east Dolomites with Ra Bujela followed directly by Fun Bob and a Lago di Auronzo walk without a mid-day lodging return, Ponte Tibetano, Val Cimoliana and the Auronzo Civic Museum, an extended Tre Cime day, Braies plus Col de Varda, and Cinque Torri combined with Lagazuoi and a Passo Giau sunset → unhurried Great Dolomites Road transfer via Passo Pordoi, Lago di Carezza and Alpine Coaster Gardonè near closing → confirmed Laion west-base Airbnb with Seceda tandem paragliding, Val d'Anna and Ortisei, Alpe di Siusi plus a one-hour horse ride and Castelrotto, Cinema delle Odle from Zannes and Santa Maddalena at sunset, Bressanone and Chiusa, Passo Gardena, Vallunga, a 3–4 hour e-bike morning and a relaxed Bolzano final day → final night in Laion → early direct drive to Target Rent and VCE on flight day

places.name: Fun Bob Auronzo — Monte Agudo

places.name: Val Cimoliana

places.name: Rifugio Pordenone
places.address: Località Pian Meluzzo, 33080 Cimolais PN, Italy

places.name: Snow Service Cortina
places.address: Via Guglielmo Marconi 12/C, 32043 Cortina d'Ampezzo BL, Italy
places.notes: 1–17 Sep opening hours: 08:30–12:30 and 14:30–19:00. Call ahead to reserve two complete EN 958 via-ferrata sets for fitting at opening on 12 Sep and confirm the cancellation/payment policy. places.name: Piè Tofana – Duca d'Aosta chairlift

places.name: Rifugio Duca d'Aosta

places.name: P1 – Parcheggio Lago di Braies

places.name: Chiesa di Santa Maddalena – Val di Funes
places.notes: Open-access village and panorama paths. Scheduled for golden hour and sunset on 20 Sep: be at the selected public viewpoint by 17:15, astronomical sunset is 19:15 and civil twilight ends about 19:45. Stay on public paths and respect private fields.

places.name: Parcheggio Malga Zannes (P1)
places.notes: Plan A trailhead on 20 Sep for the 9.1 km Adolf Munkel loop, officially about 2h47 with 433 m ascent. The schedule adds time for Cinema delle Odle and lunch. Verify and reserve parking online when the 2026 date is released.

places.name: Cinema delle Odle / Geislerkino — Geisleralm
places.address: Alm 13 / Zans, 39040 Funes BZ, Italy

On Sunday 20 Sep the hut is officially open 10:00–17:00; summer season runs 14 May–8 Nov with Monday closed. Lunch is scheduled 11:30–12:30, followed by descent to Zannes.

places.name: Passo Gardena

places.notes: Preferred rental for the 23 Sep self-guided e-bike morning. Published hardtail rate: €55 for 4 hours; helmet about €3. Ask the shop to confirm and preload an easy Rodaval–Vallunga route.

places.name: Vallunga

places.name: Pasticceria Panificio Alverà

places.name: Fermeda-Hütte

places.name: GARDENAFLY — Paragliding Tandem Flights
places.address: Streda Sacun 39, 39046 Ortisei, Italy
places.notes: Plan A for 18 Sep after a shortened Seceda ridge walk: panoramic Seceda-to-Ortisei tandem flight, about 15–20 minutes airborne and 1.5 hours total. Published price €190 per person; optional GoPro photo/video package €25 per person; lift ticket excluded. Confirm two pilots and a mountain rendezvous. Weather fallback: 24 Sep morning.

places.name: Maneggio Unterlanzin
places.notes: Plan A for 19 Sep after the Alpe di Siusi walk and lunch. One-hour accompanied ride for beginners or advanced riders, €33 per person, helmet included, no gallop, maximum 90 kg. Current Google Maps driving estimate from Ortisei: 22 minutes / 12.8 km.

places.name: Fly 2 Dolomites — Tandem Flights
places.address: S.da Val d'Anna 4, 39046 Ortisei, Italy
places.notes: Best logistical backup for the Seceda flight: €190 per person and the official FAQ explicitly allows a mountain meeting by arrangement. Google Maps 5.0/5 from 518 reviews. Use if Gardenafly cannot provide two pilots or a top rendezvous.

places.name: Tandem-Paragliding.com
places.address: Via Kleinmichl 1, 39040 Kastelruth, Italy

places.name: Maneggio Ortisei
places.address: Strada Passua 5, 39040 Ortisei, Italy
places.notes: Closest horse-riding backup to the Ortisei base. Official tourism listing shows nature excursions and daily 08:00–19:00 opening, but no direct one-hour price. A Val Gardena Active 45-minute saddle activity is €60 standard and does not run on the planned Saturday.

places.name: Scuola d'equitazione Pozzamanigoni
places.address: Streda La Selva 51, 39048 Selva di Val Gardena, Italy
places.notes: Scenic Selva backup with Google Maps 4.8/5 from 19 reviews. A current third-party booking listing shows about €80 per person for 1.5 hours, making it materially more expensive than Unterlanzin for the requested one-hour ride.

places.name: Messner Mountain Museum Corones
places.notes: Article-derived Plan B museum for a partial-weather day; access and lifts must be verified before use.

places.name: SanBrite

places.name: Ristorante Tivoli Cortina
places.notes: Article-derived fine-dining option saved to the map only; it does not replace any itinerary meal.

places.name: Lago di Landro / Dürrensee
places.notes: Natural 15–30 minute photo stop on the 15 Sep return from Braies to Cortina. Google Maps currently estimates about 32 minutes from Braies and 28 minutes onward to Cortina.

places.name: Val Fiscalina / Fischleintal
places.notes: Plan B easy valley walk, not an addition to a full Tre Cime or Braies day. From the Fiscalina parking the official easy approach to Rifugio Fondo Valle is about 30 minutes each way; current parking is paid and cannot be reserved.

places.name: Cadini di Misurina viewpoint / Punto Panoramico Dolomiti
places.notes: Conditional only: no wind or rain, good visibility and both travelers comfortable with exposure. Use as a short alternative from Rifugio Auronzo, not after completing the full Tre Cime loop.

places.name: Prato Piazza / Plätzwiese

places.name: Passo delle Erbe / Würzjoch
places.notes: Plan B only after the 20 Sep redesign selected Zannes and Cinema delle Odle to stay with the same Odle range before Santa Maddalena sunset. Keep Passo delle Erbe for a separate clear-weather half day; the official page warns that SP29 is narrow and partly single-lane.

places.name: Belvedere di Canazei / Col dei Rossi
places.notes: Conditional replacement on the 17 Sep transfer, not a 15-minute roadside stop. The 2026 Canazei–Pecol and Pecol–Col dei Rossi lifts are published for 08:30–17:30/17:20 on this date; allow 2–3 hours and use only by replacing another stop.

places.name: Passo Rolle
places.notes: Excellent but geographically remote full-day alternative with Baita Segantini and Val Venegia. Google Maps currently estimates about 1h56 each way from Ortisei, so it is not a short stop in the existing route.

places.name: Val Venegia
places.notes: One of the best walks from the TikTok set, but only as a dedicated southern day. Prefer the easy out-and-back from Pian dei Casoni toward Malga Venegiota; do not attempt the official seven-hour full circuit within the current itinerary.

places.name: Baita Segantini
places.notes: Conditional Passo Rolle hike: the official route reaches the hut in about 40–60 minutes on a comfortable track. Pair with Val Venegia only on a dedicated southern day.

places.name: Lago Welsperg
places.notes: Map-only photo stop from the second TikTok. Use only if the dedicated Passo Rolle/Val Venegia day is selected; do not add a separate drive for it.

places.name: Lago di Auronzo / Lago di Santa Caterina
places.address: 32041 Auronzo di Cadore BL, Italy
places.notes: Open-access lakeside and town walk scheduled on 12 Sep after Fun Bob and before dinner. It replaces the rejected mid-day lodging return and keeps the active day continuous outside the accommodation. Weather and daylight are the only operational constraints.

places.name: Museo Palazzo Corte Metto — Auronzo Civic Museum

places.notes: Added as the light second activity on Sunday 13 Sep after Val Cimoliana. The official Auronzo page publishes continuous June–September opening of 10:00–19:00; the scheduled 16:00–17:30 block is inside that window. Recheck the live notice shortly before travel.

places.notes: Food option around Misurina rather than near the Auronzo lodging. Google Maps showed 4.5/5, €20–30 and current regular hours Mon–Fri 10:00–15:00 and 18:30–21:00, Sat–Sun 10:00–21:00. Use only after September reconfirmation; it is not suitable for the early breakfasts.

places.name: Bucintoro Auronzo
places.address: Via Zardus, 32041 Auronzo di Cadore BL, Italy
places.notes: Flexible casual option by Lago di Auronzo for breakfast, club sandwiches or dinner. Google Maps showed 4.1/5, €10–20 and current business-updated hours 08:00–03:00 daily. It is the only breakfast candidate in the supplied list, but all current east-base departures are before 08:00, so use it only on a delayed/fallback morning after reconfirming September hours.

It is therefore not a reliable itinerary option for this trip unless the restaurant confirms reopening for the exact date.

itinerary.description: Confirmed two-night stay for two adults. Expected arrival is after the flight and airport transfer; notify the property about late arrival if required.

itinerary.title: Buy a Venetian mask — La Bauta
itinerary.description:
Primary shop: La Bauta, San Polo 2867. Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/place/La+Bauta/@45.4359844,12.3273012,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x477eb1c5cb01003b:0xb3f00e3ca4c90999!8m2!3d45.4359844!4d12.3273012!16s%2Fg%2F11c60kg_lk

itinerary.description: Replacement rental pickup is planned for 13:30; the booking request is not yet confirmed. Inspect and photograph the car, confirm fuel/deposit/toll rules and load offline maps.

itinerary.title: Target Rent → Designer Outlet Noventa di Piave
itinerary.description: Allow about 35 minutes plus the A4/E70 toll and parking.

itinerary.title: Designer Outlet Noventa di Piave — shopping and tax free
itinerary.description: Shop and complete tax-free paperwork after the 13:30 rental pickup. Official Friday opening hours are 10:00–20:00; finish the main shopping block before the dedicated 18:30 dinner.

itinerary.title: Dinner — Noventa outlet
itinerary.description: Dedicated dinner inside the outlet while it is open 10:00–20:00. Leave by 19:30 so the supermarket stop is protected.

itinerary.title: Supermarket — breakfast and sandwiches for 12 Sep
itinerary.description: Buy breakfast, water, trail snacks and lunch sandwiches for 12 Sep. Official Friday hours are 08:30–20:30; aim to reach the checkout by 20:15.

itinerary.title: Eurospar Noventa di Piave → confirmed Auronzo lodging
itinerary.description: Continue via A27 after the supermarket. The block keeps the prior Google Maps estimate plus a small night-driving margin; late or self check-in is still awaiting Piero's confirmation.

itinerary.title: Arrival and late check-in — Bella casa vacanze
itinerary.description: Navigate to the exact confirmed Airbnb location at Via Corte 13. Normal check-in starts at 14:00 with building staff; late or self check-in around 22:35–22:55 is still awaiting Piero's confirmation.

itinerary.title: Breakfast and preliminary Ra Bujela go/no-go
itinerary.description: Check the official ARPAV Dolomites bulletin, Duca d'Aosta webcam, thunderstorm timing, wind and live lift status before leaving Auronzo. If clearly unsafe, do not rent the equipment; keep the dedicated 13 Sep Ponte Tibetano and Val Cimoliana day and cancel Ra Bujela rather than chasing the final lift day.

itinerary.title: Auronzo anchor → Snow Service Cortina
itinerary.description: Google Maps currently estimates about 51 minutes for 36 km. The block includes parking and a 15-minute margin before the shop opens.

itinerary.title: Snow Service fitting and final go/no-go
itinerary.description: At opening, fit two pre-reserved complete sets: helmet, harness and EN 958 energy-absorbing lanyard. Make the final go/no-go only after the current webcam/lift check and the shop fitting. If no-go, cancel the ferrata and continue with a safe Cortina fallback; 13 Sep is now reserved for Ponte Tibetano and Val Cimoliana.

itinerary.title: Drive to Piè Tofana
itinerary.description: Park at the Piè Tofana–Duca d'Aosta chairlift. The later start is deliberate because the equipment is collected that morning.

itinerary.title: Piè Tofana → Rifugio Duca d'Aosta
itinerary.description: Published summer 2026 hours are 08:30–17:00; adult return fare €18.

itinerary.title: Via ferrata Ra Bujela — conservative 3-hour block
itinerary.description: The official hut-to-hut route time is 1h45. Reserve 3h from Duca d'Aosta back to Duca d'Aosta for mutual checks, the short approach, instruction/hesitation, queues, a calm pace and the descent. Do not combine with Ra Pegna. The first vertical section and the exposed corner after the two bridges require particular care.

metadata.officialTime: 1h45, start and finish at Rifugio Duca d'Aosta
metadata.difficulty: Officially easy, but exposed and vertical in places.
metadata.requirements: Suitable prior via-ferrata experience or a guide; full EN 958 kit; dry cable; no rain, thunderstorm or strong wind.

itinerary.title: Packed lunch and recovery — Rifugio Duca d'Aosta
itinerary.description: Use the sandwiches bought on 11 Sep and carry water/snacks. Hut service is not required for the plan; if the kitchen is open, it is optional.

itinerary.title: Chairlift descent and return to the car
itinerary.description: Descend with more than two hours of margin before the published 17:00 final service.

itinerary.title: Piè Tofana → Snow Service Cortina
itinerary.description: Return directly to the shop; Lago Pianozes is removed so the equipment hand-back and Fun Bob closing time stay protected.

itinerary.title: Return via-ferrata equipment
itinerary.description: Return the equipment the same day whether the ferrata ran or was cancelled. Snow Service afternoon opening hours are 14:30–19:00, so this hand-back is within published service hours; there is no 13 Sep equipment hold.

itinerary.title: Snow Service Cortina → Fun Bob Monte Agudo
itinerary.description: Drive directly from the equipment-return shop to Fun Bob. Do not route through or stop at the lodging: the active day stays continuous outside the accommodation until after dinner. The 55-minute block is based on the existing Cortina–Auronzo route estimate plus arrival and parking margin.

itinerary.title: Fun Bob Auronzo — earlier afternoon block
itinerary.description: Go straight into ticketing and rides after arriving from Cortina. Official hours are 10:00–13:00 and 14:00–18:00; daily 2026 operation runs through 13 Sep only and service is suspended in rain. The 16:10–17:30 block brings the activity forward while retaining 30 minutes before closing.

metadata.fallback: If rain suspends Fun Bob, extend the Lago di Auronzo and town walk before an earlier dinner.

itinerary.title: Lago di Auronzo and short town walk
itinerary.description: Open-access easy lakeside and town stroll after Fun Bob, before dinner. No lodging stop. Shorten only if Fun Bob queues extend; weather and daylight are the practical constraints.

itinerary.title: Dinner — Auronzo
itinerary.description: Dedicated dinner after Fun Bob and the lakeside/town walk. Preferred nearby shortlist: Pizzeria La Pineta, Ristorante La Stadiera or casual Bucintoro. Reconfirm Saturday 12 Sep service and reserve where needed. Return to the lodging and shower only after dinner, when the day is finished.

itinerary.title: Auronzo anchor → Ponte Tibetano
itinerary.description: Google Maps currently estimates about 35 minutes for 26.8 km. Park near the Ansogne access and keep valuables out of sight.

itinerary.title: Ponte Tibetano — bridge walk and photos
itinerary.description: Use the easy roughly 10-minute approach, cross the 103 m suspension bridge, take photos and return to the car. This is a short stop followed by onward travel, not a separate long hike.

itinerary.title: Ponte Tibetano → Rifugio Pordenone / Val Cimoliana
itinerary.description: Google Maps estimates roughly 1h02 to Rifugio Pordenone; the 1h15 block covers the summer toll and cautious driving on the partly unpaved upper-valley road. After heavy rain, stop in the lower valley and use the fallback route.

itinerary.title: Val Cimoliana — Campanile di Val Montanaia belvederes
itinerary.description: Follow the official easy belvedere route from Rifugio Pordenone: about 3 km, 2 hours and 330 m ascent, with a small time margin. Turn around if the trail is wet, damaged or visibility deteriorates.

metadata.officialRoute: Belvederi del Campanile di Val Montanaia

itinerary.title: Lunch at Rifugio Pordenone
itinerary.description: Confirm opening and kitchen service shortly before the day and carry a packed lunch as backup.

itinerary.title: Short Pian Meluzzo valley stroll
itinerary.description: A flat, tightly time-boxed photo and recovery stop near the valley floor; skip if lunch or the main hike ran late so the museum window remains protected.

itinerary.title: Val Cimoliana → Auronzo lodging
itinerary.description: Allow up to 1h45 for the return, including the slow upper-valley road. Continue to the nearby civic museum after a short arrival buffer.

itinerary.title: Auronzo Civic Museum — Palazzo Corte Metto
itinerary.description: New light Plan A activity close to the lodging after the valley day. The official Auronzo page publishes continuous June–September hours of 10:00–19:00, so the Sunday 16:00–17:30 block fits. Recheck the live notice before the trip; if the valley return runs late, shorten rather than rush.

itinerary.title: Dinner — Auronzo
itinerary.description: Dedicated early dinner and hydration before the Tre Cime start. Preferred near-base shortlist: Pizzeria La Pineta, Ristorante La Stadiera or Bucintoro; reconfirm Sunday service and reserve where needed. Shower only after dinner.

itinerary.title: Auronzo anchor → Rifugio Auronzo parking
itinerary.description: Google Maps currently estimates about 52 minutes for 32.1 km. Use the reserved parking slot and arrive before the planned 07:30 start.

itinerary.title: Tre Cime di Lavaredo loop — extended scenic pace
itinerary.description: Arrive at Rifugio Auronzo parking by 07:30. Light-medium 10 km loop, normally 4–5 hours; this block adds photo and recovery time without adding Cadini after the full loop. Carry layers, water and sandwiches. The natural trail itself has no commercial opening hours; the reserved parking window governs access.

itinerary.title: Packed lunch on the Tre Cime route
itinerary.description: Eat the packed lunch when the route and weather allow; do not rely on rifugi service.

itinerary.title: Lago di Misurina recovery stop
itinerary.description: Longer easy lakeside recovery stop after the extended Tre Cime block; skip if the hike runs late or weather worsens. Cadini remains a replacement, not an addition.

itinerary.title: Misurina → Auronzo anchor
itinerary.description: Allow about 35 minutes for the return, then keep a short buffer before dinner.

itinerary.title: Dinner — Auronzo
itinerary.description: Dedicated recovery dinner after Tre Cime. Preferred near-base shortlist: Pizzeria La Pineta, Ristorante La Stadiera or Bucintoro. Reconfirm Monday 14 Sep service; Al Tabià is an extra option only after direct hours confirmation.

itinerary.title: Auronzo anchor → Lago di Braies
itinerary.description: Google Maps currently estimates about 1h15 for 59.7 km. The block includes a small parking margin; use the reserved parking confirmation.

itinerary.title: Lago di Braies: boat and loop
itinerary.description: Use reserved parking, arrive early, take a 45-minute shared boat if operating, then complete the easy lake loop.

metadata.fallback: Dobbiaco and San Candido easy town day

itinerary.title: Lunch near Braies/Dobbiaco
itinerary.description: Choose a reserved or low-friction lunch after leaving the lakeshore crowd.

itinerary.title: Lago di Landro roadside photo stop
itinerary.description: Natural short stop on the return toward Auronzo: 15–30 minutes by the lake, with no separate hike. Skip only if Braies or lunch ran late.

itinerary.title: Lago di Landro → Col de Varda chairlift
itinerary.description: Short continuation toward Misurina instead of returning early to the lodging. Park and buy tickets promptly; skip if Braies or lunch ran late enough to compromise the safe descent margin.

itinerary.title: Col de Varda — chairlift, panorama and short walk
itinerary.description: New light second activity: ascend, enjoy the panoramic terrace and a short easy walk near Rifugio Col de Varda, then start the descent by 16:20. The official summer page publishes 09:00–16:45 chairlift hours from June through September; verify exact 15 Sep 2026 operation and do not attempt the longer Rifugio Città di Carpi hike in this late window.

itinerary.title: Col de Varda → Auronzo lodging
itinerary.description: Return after the chairlift descent with a small traffic margin. This is not a shower stop; showers are only after the final activity or meal at night.

itinerary.title: Rest and next-day weather check — no shower
itinerary.description: Sit down, drink, charge devices and check ARPAV, the 5 Torri webcam, Lagazuoi wind/lift status and the Passo Giau sunset forecast. No shower and no laundry before dinner; the single trip laundry block remains on the first evening at the final Ortisei anchor.

itinerary.title: Dinner — Auronzo
itinerary.description: Dedicated dinner, followed by the night shower and an early night. Preferred near-base shortlist: Pizzeria La Pineta, Ristorante La Stadiera or Bucintoro; reconfirm Tuesday 15 Sep service and reserve where needed.

itinerary.title: Cinque Torri weather and lift check
itinerary.description: Check ARPAV, the 5 Torri webcam and current lift status before leaving Auronzo. Cinque Torri is the fixed Plan A anchor for today.

itinerary.title: Auronzo anchor → Bai de Dones
itinerary.description: Google Maps currently estimates about 1h07 for 47.5 km. The block includes parking so you are ready for the 09:00 opening.

itinerary.title: Cinque Torri — lift, trenches and viewpoints
itinerary.description: Take the chairlift, follow the easy M5a/M5b First World War museum paths and viewpoints near Rifugio Scoiattoli, and keep the total walking block to about 2h30. The chairlift is published to operate 09:00–17:00 on this date.

itinerary.title: Lunch near Cinque Torri
itinerary.description: Prefer Rifugio Scoiattoli if operating, or use the existing Averau option; confirm service and carry a snack fallback.

itinerary.title: 5 Torri chairlift descent
itinerary.description: Descend early, with a wide margin before the final 17:00 service, then continue to the former Plan B anchor at Lagazuoi.

itinerary.title: Bai de Dones → Funivia Lagazuoi
itinerary.description: Short transfer to Passo Falzarego with parking and ticket margin.

itinerary.title: Lagazuoi — summit viewpoints and history walk
itinerary.description: Add this former Plan B anchor after Cinque Torri: cable car, easy summit viewpoints and a short history walk, not a long tunnel route. Official hours: first lift 09:00, last uphill 16:40 and last descent 17:00; be in the descent queue by 16:35.

itinerary.title: Lagazuoi → Passo Giau
itinerary.description: Continue only with clear weather and open roads. The full Auronzo–Cinque Torri–Lagazuoi–Giau–Auronzo driving circuit is currently about 3 hours in Google Maps.

itinerary.title: Early packed dinner — Passo Giau
itinerary.description: Dedicated early dinner from packed food/thermos so the sunset window does not depend on unverified restaurant service. Passo Giau is open-access; road and weather conditions govern the visit.

itinerary.title: Passo Giau golden hour and sunset
itinerary.description: Stay outside through the 19:21 astronomical sunset near Cortina, then leave promptly. Use only in clear, calm conditions and carry warm layers/headlamps.

itinerary.title: Passo Giau → Auronzo lodging
itinerary.description: Return after sunset with a conservative night-driving margin and arrive around the requested 21:00.

itinerary.title: Pack, clean the lodging or leave the €40 cleaner fee
itinerary.description: Pack, organize the car, download the next day’s route and leave the lodging according to the host's instructions: either clean up after yourselves, including kitchen, rubbish and belongings, or leave/pay the agreed €40 cleaner fee. Confirm the exact payment method in the booking messages. No laundry on 16 Sep; shower only now, after the final outing.

itinerary.title: Great Dolomites Road — Auronzo anchor → Passo Pordoi
itinerary.description: Google Maps currently estimates about 1h58 for 80.7 km. Join the classic Bolzano–Cortina road sequence at Passo Pordoi, using offline navigation only if weather, visibility and road conditions are suitable.

metadata.fallback: Use the safer direct Auronzo–Ortisei route if passes or weather are unsuitable.

itinerary.title: Passo Pordoi viewpoint stop
itinerary.description: Short photo and coffee stop; no long walk or lift commitment on the transfer day. Belvedere di Canazei is a 2–3 hour lift alternative only if it replaces this stop or Lago di Carezza and the day is still on schedule.

itinerary.title: Passo Pordoi → Lago di Carezza
itinerary.description: Continue west along the planned Great Dolomites Road sequence, allowing extra time for slow pass traffic.

itinerary.title: Lago di Carezza short lakeside stop
itinerary.description: Use the managed viewpoint/lakeside path for a short stop, then continue toward Predazzo rather than rushing to an early Ortisei check-in.

itinerary.title: Lago di Carezza → Predazzo
itinerary.description: Continue toward the Gardonè cable-car base. Google Maps currently estimates about 4h38 total driving for the full Auronzo–Pordoi–Carezza–Predazzo–Ortisei route.

itinerary.title: Lunch — Predazzo
itinerary.description: Dedicated unhurried lunch before the town walk and final Gardonè operating window. Select a place only after confirming Thursday kitchen hours.

itinerary.title: Predazzo town walk
itinerary.description: Use the flexible transfer day for an easy town walk and coffee before driving to the cable-car parking. There is no early check-in target in Ortisei.

itinerary.title: Predazzo–Gardonè cable car and setup
itinerary.description: The cable car operates 08:30–17:45 on 17 Sep. Buy the combined ticket and reach the coaster with enough time for the final operating block.

itinerary.title: Alpine Coaster Gardonè — near closing
itinerary.description: Use the requested late slot near site closing. Official 2026 operation is daily 13 Jun–20 Sep, 10:00–17:00, weather permitting; the cable car down remains open until 17:45.

itinerary.title: Gardonè descent and drive to the confirmed Laion Airbnb
itinerary.description: Descend immediately after the coaster, then drive to the exact Airbnb coordinates. Google Maps currently estimates 1h22 / 70.1 km from Gardonè; this block adds cable-car descent, parking exit and a road buffer. The reservation allows check-in from 16:00 and uses a lockbox, so there is no reason to cut the touring day short.

itinerary.title: Laion check-in and start the trip's single laundry load
itinerary.description: Use the lockbox, park in the garage and start the only planned laundry load of the trip. This is the unavoidable first arrival at the new anchor, not a rest or shower stop; leave again for Chiusa and shower only after dinner when the day is over.

itinerary.title: Drive to Chiusa and short old-town walk
itinerary.description: Google Maps estimates about 14 minutes from the Laion lodging to Chiusa. Use the remaining time for a short open-access old-town orientation before dinner.

itinerary.title: Dinner — Chiusa
itinerary.description: Dedicated late dinner after the transfer day. Reserve only a Thursday restaurant that confirms kitchen service through this window.

itinerary.title: Chiusa → Laion lodging
itinerary.description: Google Maps estimates about 14 minutes / 10.9 km. Return only after dinner; finish the laundry and shower now, after the active day has ended.

itinerary.title: Laion → Seceda cable car and parking
itinerary.description: Google Maps currently estimates 17 minutes / 12.6 km. The 40-minute block includes the drive, parking and walking to the first practical lift.

itinerary.title: Seceda lift and compact ridge walk
itinerary.description: Take the first practical lift from Ortisei and keep the iconic ridge walk to about 75–90 minutes, returning to the agreed take-off point by 10:20. Do not rush if footing or visibility is poor.

metadata.fallback: If the flight is cancelled, continue the original Seceda ridge morning until 12:20 and descend by lift.

itinerary.title: GARDENAFLY tandem paragliding — Seceda → Ortisei
itinerary.description: Two simultaneous panoramic tandem flights, about 15–20 minutes airborne and 1.5 hours total, landing near Annatal/Ortisei. Confirm two pilots and a mountain rendezvous before booking; if Gardenafly requires a valley meeting, use Fly2's published mountain-meeting option or move the flight to the 24 Sep weather buffer.

itinerary.title: Lunch in Annatal or Ortisei after landing
itinerary.description: Eat close to the landing area after the flight. If the flight is cancelled, retain the original hut/Ortisei lunch after descending from Seceda.

itinerary.title: Val d'Anna easy walk after landing
itinerary.description: Continue directly from lunch into the easy Annatal/Val d'Anna valley walk. This replaces the old recovery-at-home block: do not return to Laion, change clothes or shower during the active day.

itinerary.title: Ortisei centre and aperitivo walk
itinerary.description: Stay in Ortisei for an easy centre walk, shops or aperitivo before dinner; no lodging return.

itinerary.title: Dinner — Ortisei
itinerary.description: Dedicated dinner after Seceda, the flight and Val d'Anna. No laundry today because the single planned load was completed on the first evening at the final anchor.

itinerary.title: Ortisei → Laion lodging
itinerary.description: Google Maps estimates about 15–17 minutes. Return only after dinner; shower at night after the day is finished.

itinerary.title: Laion → Mont Sëuc cable car and parking
itinerary.description: Google Maps currently estimates 15 minutes / 12.1 km; the block includes parking and walking to the station.

itinerary.title: Alpe di Siusi from Ortisei
itinerary.description: Use the Ortisei cable car for a broad meadow walk with an easy turnaround and weather-aware pacing.

itinerary.title: Lunch on Alpe di Siusi
itinerary.description: Preselect one hut and keep a packed backup in case of closure or queues.

itinerary.title: Descend from Alpe di Siusi and drive to Maneggio Unterlanzin
itinerary.description: Finish the gondola descent, collect the car and continue to Unterlanzin. Google Maps currently estimates 21 minutes / 12.9 km from the Mont Sëuc station; the block includes the lift, parking exit and arrival margin.

itinerary.title: Horse assignment, helmet and briefing
itinerary.description: Confirm each rider is within the published 90 kg limit, disclose experience accurately and follow the guide’s instructions. Helmets are included.

itinerary.title: One-hour guided horse ride — Unterlanzin
itinerary.description: One-hour accompanied outing for beginners or experienced riders. The provider specifies no gallop for safety and insurance reasons. Contact the stable if weather is poor.

itinerary.title: Castelrotto village walk
itinerary.description: Unterlanzin is about 3 minutes / 1.6 km from Castelrotto. Continue directly into an easy village walk instead of returning to the lodging or scheduling rest.

itinerary.title: Dinner — Castelrotto
itinerary.description: Dedicated dinner after the horse ride and village walk; confirm Saturday kitchen hours.

itinerary.title: Castelrotto → Laion lodging
itinerary.description: Google Maps estimates about 21 minutes / 15.2 km. Return after dinner and shower only after the active day ends.

itinerary.title: Laion → Zannes trailhead
itinerary.description: Google Maps currently estimates 41 minutes / 28.3 km. The 50-minute block includes access to the paid Zannes parking. Confirm the 2026 parking reservation/access instructions before the trip.

metadata.fallback: Santa Maddalena village and Chiusa if the trail weather is poor

itinerary.title: Adolf Munkel trail to Cinema delle Odle
itinerary.description: Hike from Zannes on paths 6, 35 and 36A toward Geisleralm and the panoramic terrace. The official direct approach is about 1h40; the full official loop is 9.1 km, about 2h47 and 433 m ascent. The trail is open-access and depends on conditions.

itinerary.title: Cinema delle Odle and lunch — Geisleralm
itinerary.description: Enjoy the Geislerkino/Cinema delle Odle panorama and eat at Geisleralm. Official Sunday hours on 20 Sep are 10:00–17:00; carry a packed backup.

itinerary.title: Descend to Zannes
itinerary.description: Return via trail 36/Dusler toward the Zannes parking. Keep the time margin so the sunset plan is not compressed.

itinerary.title: Zannes → Santa Maddalena
itinerary.description: Drive down the valley and park only in the signed public areas.

itinerary.title: Santa Maddalena and San Giovanni village walk
itinerary.description: Easy village and church walk while the light is still high. The villages and public paths are open-access; respect private fields and any local vehicle restrictions.

itinerary.title: Early dinner and sunset setup — Santa Maddalena
itinerary.description: Use a confirmed local restaurant or a substantial packed dinner before walking to the public panorama point. Eating before golden hour is safer than depending on a late Sunday kitchen after sunset; carry a warm layer and headlamp.

itinerary.title: Santa Maddalena — Odle golden hour and sunset
itinerary.description: Stay at the public panorama point while the Odle peaks catch the evening light. Astronomical sunset is 19:15 and civil twilight ends about 19:45; remain only if weather and footing are safe.

itinerary.title: Santa Maddalena → Laion lodging
itinerary.description: Google Maps currently estimates 33 minutes / 23.3 km; the block retains a night-driving margin.

itinerary.title: End of day at the Laion lodging
itinerary.description: Dinner was completed before sunset. Return now, after the final outdoor activity; shower only at night once the day is finished.

itinerary.title: Laion → Bressanone
itinerary.description: Google Maps currently estimates 21 minutes / 17.8 km; the block includes parking. If a major west mountain anchor was lost to weather, use this day for that anchor instead and compress the cities to a later afternoon.

itinerary.title: Bressanone old town and riverside walk
itinerary.description: Concrete open-access Plan A for a Monday buffer day: old town, cathedral square and an easy riverside walk. No lodging return.

itinerary.title: Lunch — Bressanone
itinerary.description: Dedicated Monday lunch before continuing to Chiusa; choose a place after confirming Monday service.

itinerary.title: Bressanone → Chiusa
itinerary.description: Google Maps currently estimates 14 minutes / 11.9 km; the block includes parking.

itinerary.title: Chiusa old town and optional Sabiona path
itinerary.description: Explore the old town and, if dry, take the public uphill path toward Sabiona/Säben for views; exterior access is the plan, not an assumed monastery opening. Stay out until dinner.

itinerary.title: Dinner — Chiusa
itinerary.description: Dedicated early dinner; confirm Monday kitchen hours.

itinerary.title: Chiusa → Laion lodging
itinerary.description: Google Maps estimates about 14 minutes / 10.9 km. Return after dinner; no mid-day lodging stop and no additional laundry.

itinerary.title: Laion → Passo Gardena
itinerary.description: Google Maps currently estimates 43 minutes / 30.6 km; the block includes viewpoint parking.

itinerary.title: Passo Gardena scenic morning
itinerary.description: Weather-dependent scenic stops and short walks, not a major exposed hike.

itinerary.title: Passo Gardena → Vallunga / Selva
itinerary.description: Google Maps currently estimates 21 minutes / 12.2 km; the block includes parking.

itinerary.title: Lunch — Selva
itinerary.description: Dedicated lunch close to the Vallunga trailhead with simple parking.

itinerary.title: Vallunga easy out-and-back
itinerary.description: Follow official path 14 from the valley entrance toward San Silvestro chapel and the meadows. The full official route is an easy 7.5 km / about 2 hours / 201 m ascent; the extra margin allows photos or an early turnaround.

itinerary.title: Selva village walk and café
itinerary.description: Remain in Val Gardena after the walk for an easy village/café block; no lodging return before dinner.

itinerary.title: Dinner — Selva / Val Gardena
itinerary.description: Dedicated dinner after Vallunga. Confirm Tuesday kitchen hours.

itinerary.title: Vallunga / Selva → Laion lodging
itinerary.description: Google Maps currently estimates 29 minutes / 21.3 km; the block retains a small evening margin.

itinerary.title: Laion → On the Rocks, Ortisei
itinerary.description: Google Maps currently estimates 17 minutes / 12.6 km; the block includes parking and walking to the shop.

itinerary.title: E-bike pickup and fitting — On the Rocks
itinerary.description: Collect two electric hardtails, helmets and locks. Ask the shop to confirm and preload the easiest suitable Rodaval–Vallunga out-and-back route and current trail conditions.

metadata.fallback: Retain the original relaxed flex morning if weather or route conditions are poor.

itinerary.title: Self-guided e-bike — Ortisei, Rodaval and Vallunga
itinerary.description: Ride from Ortisei toward Santa Cristina and Selva on the easiest shop-confirmed Rodaval/Val Gardena cycle route, using Vallunga as the scenic turnaround objective. Turn back according to battery, conditions and the four-hour rental deadline; avoid technical MTB trails.

metadata.fullSellarondaRejected: The official guided circuit is about 8 hours and 65 km, which does not fit the requested 3–4 hour inexpensive ride.

itinerary.title: Return e-bikes
itinerary.description: Return the bikes within the four-hour window and report any mechanical issue to the shop.

itinerary.title: Farewell lunch in Ortisei
itinerary.description: Book a pleasant but cancellable final-base lunch close to the rental shop.

itinerary.title: Ortisei centre and easy Val d'Anna extension
itinerary.description: Continue from lunch into an easy Ortisei/Val d'Anna walk, shops and café time. This replaces the old return/rest/organization block: remain outside until dinner and do not return to Laion.

itinerary.title: Dinner — Ortisei
itinerary.description: Dedicated dinner after the e-bike day; confirm Wednesday kitchen hours.

itinerary.title: Ortisei → Laion lodging
itinerary.description: Google Maps estimates 16 minutes / 12.6 km. Return only after dinner; no second laundry load.

itinerary.title: Laion → Bolzano and relaxed old-town morning
itinerary.description: Google Maps currently estimates 34 minutes / 30.3 km from Laion. If the 18 Sep tandem flight was cancelled, replace this Bolzano block with the flight fallback; otherwise use the open-access old town and market streets for a low-risk final touring morning.

itinerary.title: Final touring lunch — Bolzano
itinerary.description: Dedicated final lunch in the city centre; confirm Thursday service.

itinerary.title: Bolzano old town, riverside and final shopping
itinerary.description: Keep the final afternoon urban, open-access and non-strenuous. Do not return to the lodging before the last meal.

itinerary.title: Early dinner — Bolzano
itinerary.description: Dedicated early dinner before the last drive and packing; confirm Thursday kitchen hours.

itinerary.title: Fuel, Bolzano → Laion, pack and prepare the early route
itinerary.description: Google Maps estimates about 35 minutes / 30.6 km back to Laion. Refuel on the route, then pack completely, verify Target Rent's 08:00–19:00 desk hours and 24-hour shuttle note, download the direct route and place the key according to the lockbox checkout instructions. Dinner is already complete; shower only now, after the final outing.

itinerary.title: Early wake-up and lockbox checkout
